Add Text to an Open Graph Image with ImageMagick

July 2026

This is how I'm adding text to background images for my open graph images on the site with ImageMagick.

TODO: Add alt text to images.

#!/bin/bash

magick "og-example-background.jpg" \
    \( \
      -font Arial-Bold \
      -background none \
      -fill white \
      -pointsize 98 \
      -size 820x \
      caption:"This is just a test of the title content" \
    \) \
    -gravity NorthWest \
    -geometry +60+50 \
    -composite \
    "og-example-output.jpg"
